pairs: and imploring, and weeping in this way,
and was prostrate before the temple of God,
collectus est ad eum de Israël cœtus grandis nimis virorum et mulierum et puerorum,
an exceedingly great assembly of men and women and children was gathered to him from Israel.
And the people wept with a great weeping.
Et respondit Sechenias filius Jehiel de filiis Ælam,
And Shecaniah, the son of Jehiel, from the sons of Elam,
et dixit Esdræ: Nos prævaricati sumus in Deum nostrum,
responded and said to Ezra: “We have sinned against our God,
et duximus uxores alienigenas de populis terræ:
and have taken foreign wives from the peoples of the land.
si est pœnitentia in Israël super hoc,
if there is repentance within Israel over this,
percutiamus fœdus cum Domino Deo nostro,
let us strike a pact with the Lord our God,
so that we may cast aside all the wives,
et eos qui de his nati sunt,
and those who have been born from them,
in accord with the will of the Lord,
et eorum qui timent præceptum Domini Dei nostri:
and of those who fear the precept of the Lord our God. So let it be done,
It is for you to discern,
and we shall be with you.
and he caused the leaders of the priests and the Levites,
to swear that they would act in accord with this word.
Et surrexit Esdras ante domum Dei,
And Ezra rose up before the house of God,
et abiit ad cubiculum Johanan filii Eliasib,
and he went away to the chamber of Jehohanan,
and he did not drink water.
For he was mourning the transgression of those who had arrived from the captivity.
Et missa est vox in Juda
And a voice was sent into Judah and Jerusalem,
et in Jerusalem omnibus filiis transmigrationis,
to all the sons of the transmigration,
so that they would gather together in Jerusalem.
et omnis qui non venerit in tribus diebus juxta consilium principum
And all those who would not arrive within three days,
in accord with the counsel of the leaders and the elders,
would have all his substance taken away,
et ipse abjicietur de cœtu transmigrationis.
and he would be cast out of the assembly of the transmigration.
Convenerunt igitur omnes viri Juda et Benjamin in Jerusalem tribus diebus:
all the men of Judah and of Benjamin convened in Jerusalem within three days.
This was in the ninth month,
et sedit omnis populus in platea domus Dei,
on the twentieth day of the month.
And all the people sat in the street of the house of God,
trembling because of the sin and the rain.
And Ezra, the priest, rose up,
and you have taken foreign wives,
so that you added to the offenses of Israel.
Et nunc date confessionem Domino Deo patrum vestrorum,
And now, make confession to the Lord, the God of your fathers,
et facite placitum ejus, et separamini a populis terræ,
and do what pleases him, and separate yourselves from the peoples of the land,
and they said with a great voice:
“In accord with your word to us,
Yet truly, since the people are many,
and it is the time of rain,
and we cannot endure standing outside,
et opus non est diei unius vel duorum (vehementer quippe peccavimus in sermone isto),
and this is not a task for one or two days, (for certainly we have sinned greatly in this matter,)
let leaders be appointed among the entire multitude.
et omnes in civitatibus nostris qui duxerunt uxores alienigenas veniant in temporibus statutis,
et cum his seniores per civitatem
let those who have taken foreign wives arrive at appointed times,
and with them the elders from city to city,
donec avertatur ira Dei nostri a nobis super peccato hoc.
until the wrath of our God has been averted from us over this sin.”
And so Jonathan, the son of Asahel,
and Jahzeiah, the son of Tikvah,
et Messollam et Sebethai Levites adjuverunt eos:
and the Levites Meshullam and Shabbethai assisted them.
And the sons of the transmigration did so. And Ezra,
Et abierunt Esdras sacerdos, et viri principes familiarum,
the priest, and the men who were the leaders of the families in the houses of their fathers,
in domos patrum suorum, et omnes per nomina sua,
and all according to their names, went and sat down,
et sederunt in die primo mensis decimi ut quærerent rem.
on the first day of the tenth month, so that they might examine the matter.
Et consummati sunt omnes viri, qui duxerant uxores alienigenas,
And they made an end with all the men who had taken foreign wives,
usque ad diem primam mensis primi.
by the first day of the first month.
Et inventi sunt de filiis sacerdotum qui duxerant uxores alienigenas.
And there were found among the sons of the priests some who had taken foreign wives:
From the sons of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak,
Et dederunt manus suas ut ejicerent uxores suas,
And they swore with their hands that they would cast aside their wives,
et pro delicto suo arietem de ovibus offerrent.
and that they would offer for their offense a ram from among the sheep.
And from the sons of Immer,
And from the sons of Harim,
And from the sons of Pashhur,
And from the sons of the Levites,
And from the sons of Elam,
And from the sons of Zattu,
And from the sons of Bebai,
And from the sons of Bani,
And from the sons of Pahath-moab,
And from the sons of Harim,
And from the sons of Hashum,
All these had taken foreign wives,
et fuerunt ex eis mulieres, quæ pepererant filios.
and there were among them women who had borne sons.
